result.reason: The clause adds the preferred six-month transition period at then-current rates, but it does not itself require Customer Data to be returned within 30 days in a standard machine-readable format or require certification of deletion. Merely referencing Sections 11.2 and 11.3 cannot establish compliance because their operative language is not provided, and the margin comment cannot cure that omission. It therefore does not demonstrably reach either the preferred position or the fallback, both of which require export within 30 days.
